description: Store a dataset description in your own base. The server does not fetch the source or import its data. Saving creates a managed dataset.md version for base search, collections and OKF export. Existing publication stays unchanged until publish_base. The normal base and document limits apply; extra base capacity uses the existing subscription. Metadata and public discovery have no separate fee.

coverage.description: Geographic, temporal or subject coverage, 1–300 characters.

fields.description: 1–30 fields, each with a name and description.

format.description: Source format, for example CSV or JSON, 1–40 characters.

license.description: Declared license or access terms, 1–300 characters. Not independently verified.

source_url.description: HTTPS origin URL, at most 1000 characters, without credentials.

update_frequency.description: Declared update schedule, 1–200 characters. No automatic check is performed.

name: save_base_dataset
title: Save base dataset
